result.instructions: Tools for ProWorkflow, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which projects are active, and who manages each one?"; "List the open tasks in the website redesign project that are due this week."; "How many hours did each contact log on project 123 last month?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes ProWorkflow data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run proworkflow_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run proworkflow_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run proworkflow_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. proworkflow_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: proworkflow_get_account
tools.title: Get account settings
tools.description: Get the ProWorkflow account settings: plan, currency, time and look-and-feel settings. Good first call to check the connection. API: GET /settings/account.

tools.name: proworkflow_list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: List projects, with optional search and filters (status, company, manager, last modified). Use page_number and page_size for large accounts. API: GET /projects.

q.description: Fuzzy search term across project names and numbers.

status.description: Status (activeworkstate), for example active or completed.

company_id.description: Company ID, or a comma-separated list of company IDs.

manager_id.description: Manager contact ID, or a comma-separated list.

last_modified_from.description: ISO 8601 date, or a relative value such as 12h, 5d, 2w, 1m.

last_modified_to.description: ISO 8601 date, or a relative value such as 12h, 5d, 2w, 1m.

page_number.description: Page number, starting at 1. Send with page_size.

page_size.description: Results per page. Send with page_number.

include_total_rows.description: Include the total row count in meta (slower).

tools.name: proworkflow_create_item
tools.title: Create an item
tools.description: Create a new item (task) in a project. Creates data in ProWorkflow. API: POST /projects/{projectid}/items.

phase_id.description: Phase ID (item collection) the item belongs to.

contact_ids.description: Contact (staff) IDs assigned to the item.

tools.name: proworkflow_update_item
tools.title: Update an item
tools.description: Update the fields of one item (name, description, dates, priority, assignees, phase). Send only the fields to change. To complete an item, use proworkflow_complete_items. API: PUT /projects/items/{itemid}.

contact_ids.description: Contact (staff) IDs assigned to the item.

phase_id.description: Move the item to this phase ID.

tools.name: proworkflow_complete_items
tools.title: Complete items
tools.description: Mark one or more items as complete. The API cannot reopen a completed item, so this change is final. API: PUT /projects/items/complete.

tools.name: proworkflow_add_time_record
tools.title: Add a time record
tools.description: Log time spent on an item (task) by a contact. Creates data in ProWorkflow. API: POST /time.

contact_id.description: The staff contact the time is for.

item_id.description: The item (task) the time is logged against.

start_time.description: When the work started, ISO 8601 in UTC, for example 2026-04-21T09:00:00Z.

time_allocation_id.description: Time allocation ID the time counts against.
